description: List a quiz's questions so you can review a completed, graded attempt. Read-only and never used to take a quiz. Canvas hides questions unless the instructor allows review, so this often returns a permission error or nothing.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

name: list_quiz_questions
title: List Quiz Questions
